title: This Fish Makes Slime That Grows 10,000 Times in 0.4 Seconds

scenes.text: This fish makes slime that grows 10,000 times in 0.4 seconds.
It's the hagfish. When a shark bites, it releases tiny threads and mucus.
Water hits them and the slime balloons in under half a second.
It clogs the predator's mouth and gills.
The rushing water during an attack is what sets it off.
Bite a hagfish and you bite a slime bomb. Watch it explode again.

description:
Hagfish slime expands to 10,000 times its size in about 0.4 seconds.
It clogs the mouth and gills of a predator that bites.
The water rushing in during an attack helps set it off.
Would you touch it?
first_comment: Slime bomb or ink cloud: which defense would you pick?
